$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0211-invalid-duplicate-layoutid.xml (Rule 10, D-030). NEGATIVE CASE: two Layouts share LayoutId "Dup", which violates the LayoutKey xs:key - an identity constraint, not a facet, so no per-attribute check can catch it and only a document-wide pass can. xmllint rejects the document; this parser reports it. The two layouts declare DIFFERENT dimensions, 2x2 and 3x3, so silently taking either one produces a map that renders and is wrong.
